description: Covers discovering and reusing existing research software instead of rebuilding it, using Research Software Directory (RSD) instances such as research-software-directory.org and helmholtz.software. Use PROACTIVELY when a research project is about to implement functionality that likely already exists - data readers, converters, solvers, analysis tools, domain libraries - and when the user asks whether a tool already exists, wants to find research software for a domain, or mentions the RSD. Ships bundled catalog snapshots (data/*.json) for offline candidate suggestions. (Broad prior-art surveys across publications and all sources: rseng-discovery; vetting a chosen candidate: rseng-dependency-management.)
